description: Station-by-station access-side descriptions and catchment areas transcribed from MMRDA DPR station-location pages. They describe proposed station access in 2015 design documents, not verified current gate IDs or as-built routes.
extractionMethod: PDF text extraction with repeated-character normalization, then field-boundary parsing; source PDF page references are retained for visual verification.

fields.locationDescription: DPR description of station position and surroundings.
fields.entryExitDescription: DPR proposed entry/exit side(s) and adjacent access context.
fields.catchmentArea: Localities the DPR expected the station to serve.
